title: Dtm716 - Mona Lisa
htmlContent:
Dtm716 gives us the perfect smash to make the soundtrack for the weekend on her new song “Mona Lisa”. The appeal in the sound shines through right away, with a big time sound that you see the sun shine in, as you immediately enjoy life just from hearing it. To match this she brings a major vocal performance that delivers the exciting weekend in every way, as she makes a blissful sound that you enjoy without any limits.
